# Ayush Kushwaha

Ayush Kushwaha is a product designer and full-stack engineer based in India, available for freelance projects. Ayush designs and builds SaaS products, business platforms and premium websites, covering UI/UX, motion, architecture and deployment.

## Overview
This site is the portfolio of Ayush Kushwaha. It showcases case studies of SaaS products, business platforms, ERP systems and client websites that Ayush designed and built, including AgencyOS, CATFY, Leadzenor, Karatrix, an ERP for an IP law firm, and the Seven Stars pub website.
